title: Lookup in an appended list
statement: Let $l$ and $l'$ be lists with entries in a type $\alpha$, let $j$ be a natural number, and let $d\in\alpha$ be a default value. The lookup at position $\operatorname{length}(l)+j$ in the concatenation $l++l'$, using default $d$, equals the lookup at position $j$ in $l'$, using the same default.
hypotheses_covered: Lists $l$ and $l'$ with entries in a type $\alpha$
